attBesluta.text: Really amazed at the quality of all the products I have bought off Vevor. Once again the garden beds are excellent value. Quick delivery Easy to order All in all a great place to shop
perfect for what I need and will purchase another one once I have cleared a space. The steel is sturdy and its easy to assemble, its already got a summer crop growing in it.
It's quite large. Open bottom so plants can go into the ground

The instructions imply the cross support beams to be installed in a specific way. Following the instructions caused both our garden beds to bow out in the centre. We attached the cross beams more towards the centre to avoid this. After about a month they seem solid without issue.
